## Normative-change checks (required when canon changes: DESIGN.md, PROJECT_INTENT.md, bindings, manifest policy)
- [ ] **Instrument stratification:** for every consequential effect this change touches, the *authorizing* instrument is named — and no weaker record (debt, receipt, evidence, observation, claim) is made sufficient for it anywhere in the text. (NR-scms-001: authorization-by-the-cheaper-record.)
- [ ] **Essence vs accident:** any passage distilled from an observed practice separates what the example proves from how the example happened to unfold — sequencing and defaults are chosen, not inherited.
- [ ] **Cross-clause consistency:** the change contradicts no standing clause (grep the terms it touches); a deliberate contradiction is recorded as a supersession, not left implicit.
- [ ] Declared vocabulary respected (no prohibited substitutions); one authority per statement — this change creates no second home for an existing rule.
- [ ] Compiled context regenerated; gates green; projections republished if a canonical source hash changed.
